notes.title: My Little Pony: A Maretime Bay Adventure Trading Cards are here!
notes.content:
Calling Everypony!

Put your hooves into action and continue to enjoy the Maretime Bay Adventure with Sunny and the pony gang by [b]unlocking and collecting trading cards, badges, and more.[/b]

[list]
[*] 7 Stylish Trading cards 
[*] 6 Magical Badges 
[*] 5 Ponified Profile backgrounds 
[*] 5 Enchanted Emoticons 
[/list]

Saddle up and enjoy the extraordinary adventure!
